{{Top|leg}}
The '''Star Shocked''' was a nightclub in the city of [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], half-owned by [[Dexx Molay]]. It was a two-story structure that had a bar, tables, booths, a stage and large dance floor on the ground level. The second floor was a large balcony, overlooking the dance area below. More tables, booths and a bar were up there, as well as a number of [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] tables. A number of different games of skill were present as well as an area set aside for betting on various events.
